question: Should OpenClaw core restore deprecated `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` compatibility, and should that compatibility be limited to `turn === inbound` or include the broader pre-removal legacy method names?
rationale: The code fix is small, but this is a shipped plugin SDK/runtime surface and the repo policy treats plugin API compatibility as a maintainer-owned decision.

options.title: Accept object-identical alias
options.body: Rebase this PR, keep `turn === inbound`, and land it as the narrow fix for reported old plugins calling `core.channel.turn.run()`.

options.title: Broaden legacy compatibility
options.body: Ask for a small follow-up before merge that also restores the old `turn.runPrepared` / `turn.runAssembled` style names or documents why they stay removed.

options.title: Reject core compatibility
options.body: Close this direction and require old plugins to publish migrated releases that use `channel.inbound.*`.

recommendation.title: Accept object-identical alias
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, keep `turn === inbound`, and land it as the narrow fix for reported old plugins calling `core.channel.turn.run()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The removed compatibility surface traces to `6c3740255f3a`, and this decision is about whether to reverse or narrow that removal.
